name: dental-ai-admin-backend
description: Dental AI Receptionist — Platform Super Admin Backend

scripts.dev: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('node_modules/.prisma') && fs.existsSync('../backend/node_modules/.prisma')) fs.cpSync('../backend/node_modules/.prisma', 'node_modules/.prisma', { recursive: true });" && ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only --exit-child src/index.ts
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('../backend/node_modules/.prisma')) fs.cpSync('../backend/node_modules/.prisma', 'node_modules/.prisma', { recursive: true });"
